# Tessa Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old  <sub>[v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P9](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0009), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Hollowmere  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P3](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Tessa is a blithe, dainty young girl who possesses a flawless complexion and long, reddish ringlets that are kept smooth and shaped. On her visit to the manse, she wore a pale, stiffened, and worked frock adorned with a blue sash, beaded slippers, and an intricate hat crafted of silk, lace, and blossoms.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P16](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0016), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)_

## Personality

Tessa takes great pride in her fine attire and carries out assigned tasks with determination and care. Though somewhat lisping, timid, and easily intimidated by wild antics, she attempts to remain resolute when holding onto her responsibilities.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005), [v5 c7 P12](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0012), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)_

## Traits

- Proud and mindful of her fine clothing  <sub>[v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)</sub>
- Resolute in carrying out tasks  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P12](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0012)</sub>
- Easily frightened by unusual antics  <sub>[v5 c7 P10](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0010), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)</sub>

## Goals

- Deliver a basket of early strawberries directly to Aunt Martha or Mr. Ashdown  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007)</sub>

## History

Tessa was entrusted by Tabitha with a delicate task: bringing a small basket of carefully cultivated early strawberries from Hollowmere to the Glen St. Agnes manse, with strict instructions to hand them over to no one other than Aunt Martha or Mr. Ashdown. Wearing her finest frock and an ornate hat, Tessa marched proudly up the manse hill to execute her errand. Upon reaching the lawn gate, she was confronted by Mary Stubbs, who attempted to seize the basket. Tessa resisted and refused to relinquish it, insisting on following her instructions. In retaliation, Mary performed an unsettling dance, made strange facial expressions, and eventually grabbed a large, dried codfish to chase her. Terrified by the bizarre weapon, Tessa dropped the basket, crushing the strawberries as she fled down the main street. During the pursuit, Tessa tripped and fell into a mud puddle at the end of the street, destroying her hat, dress, and slippers while bruising her pride. Miss Winifred rescued the crying child from the street and carried her home to be cleaned and comforted by Tabitha.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P4](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0004), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005), [v5 c7 P6](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0006), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P10](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0010), [v5 c7 P11](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0011), [v5 c7 P12](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0012), [v5 c7 P13](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0013), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 c7 P18](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0018)_
